taken as written

parts.note: the opening letter of the painter's name, the one to be removed
taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: To lube a machine is to apply lubricant, so lubes and oils are both verbs for greasing moving parts.

clue.text: Redesign niche Russian car as tasty Roller?

explanation.definitionFit: An enchilada is a tortilla rolled around a savoury filling, so it is a tasty thing that has been rolled.

clue.text: This person invested in American property in fact

the setter speaking of themself

explanation.definitionFit: Reality is what actually exists or is true, which is the sense of a fact as opposed to opinion.

parts.note: to vie is to compete or struggle

the point of something is its purpose

indicators.note: a power cut is an outage, so the letter for power is cut out of the word

parts.note: returning a message or serve is answering it

explanation.definitionFit: To bank on something is to depend on it, so banking and relying both mean counting on support.

explanation.walkthrough: 'Boris' suggests a politician, but his surname comes from the tennis player Becker, said in a non-rhotic accent.
explanation.definitionFit: Rebecca is Daphne du Maurier's 1938 novel, so it is the title of a well-known book.

parts.note: gen is British slang for information

indicators.note: a sound is what is heard, so the word is spelt as it is pronounced

explanation.definitionFit: Genteel describes polite, refined manners associated with good social standing, close to respectable.

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a slight trace, as in a hint of garlic
second meaning: a feeling that someone is not to be trusted

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a faint trace of a flavour or quality and a doubting feeling about honesty.

clue.text: Old car is unpredictable having been cut in half

parts.note: capricious means given to sudden changes of mood

explanation.walkthrough: Ten letters halved leave the first five.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ford Capri was a sporty coupe sold from 1969 to 1986, so it is a classic vehicle.

parts.note: Libra is the zodiac sign of the scales
RY is an abbreviation for railway

explanation.surface: An accountant balancing the ledgers of a railway company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Books' suggests accounts that need balancing, but it is a collection of reading matter.
explanation.definitionFit: A library is a collection of volumes, so the word can stand for the books themselves.

indicators.note: to break something is to smash it apart, so the letters fall into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A country breaks a trade ban on the supply of arms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' looks like a joining word but its letters belong to the material.
explanation.definitionFit: A boomerang is an Australian throwing stick, curved so that it flies back to the person who threw it.

clue.text: Inclined to strike to protect security code

indicators.note: a guard protects by surrounding, so one piece wraps around another

parts.note: to slog is to hit hard
a PIN is a personal identification number

explanation.walkthrough: 'Inclined to strike' reads as workers ready for industrial action, but 'Inclined' alone is the definition, an adjective about slopes.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inclined is set at an angle to the horizontal, which is what sloping describes.

clue.text: Called out about an endangered primate

parts.note: rang out means called out loudly
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'Called out' must first become RANG OUT before its letters are rearranged with AN.
explanation.definitionFit: The orangutan is a great ape of Borneo and Sumatra, listed as critically endangered by habitat loss.

parts.note: to low is to moo like a cow

explanation.definitionFit: Moorage is the fee paid for tying a boat up at a mooring, so it is a charge for berthing.

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Eastern European currency once had to go up

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for east or eastern

clue.text: Born an afterthought having Scottish roots

taken as written
